description: Golden questions with hand-written reference SQL. `expected` is computed by `schema-agent build-golden` against the frozen seed (erp_schema_agent clone of idempiere_seed).

cases.question: How many Fernhollow sales orders have been booked (completed or closed)?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS booked_orders FROM c_order o WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL')

cases.question: How many Fernhollow sales orders were voided?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS voided FROM c_order o WHERE o.issotrx='Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus='VO'

cases.question: What is the average order value of Fernhollow sales orders, excluding voided orders but including in-progress ones?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.grandtotal), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM c_order o WHERE o.issotrx='Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus <> 'VO'

cases.question: List the in-progress sales orders with document number, customer name and order total.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.documentno, bp.name AS customer, o.grandtotal FROM c_order o JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id = o.c_bpartner_id WHERE o.issotrx='Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus='IP'

cases.question: What is the total value of sales orders that are still in progress?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.grandtotal) AS in_progress_value FROM c_order o WHERE o.issotrx='Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus='IP'

cases.question: How many sales orders were voided in each month of 2026? Return the month and the count.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.dateordered)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS voided FROM c_order o WHERE o.issotrx='Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus='VO' AND o.dateordered >= '2026-01-01' AND o.dateordered < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many active Fernhollow SKUs are there?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_skus FROM m_product WHERE value LIKE 'FH-%' AND isactive='Y'

cases.question: Which Fernhollow products are retired? Give SKU and name.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT value AS sku, name FROM m_product WHERE value LIKE 'FH-%' AND isactive='N'

cases.question: How many active SKUs are there per product type?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT group1 AS product_type, COUNT(*) AS active_skus FROM m_product WHERE value LIKE 'FH-%' AND isactive='Y' GROUP BY group1

cases.question: How many customers do we have?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM c_bpartner WHERE value LIKE 'DEMO-C%'

cases.question: How many completed purchase orders are there?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_pos FROM c_order WHERE issotrx='N' AND documentno LIKE 'FH-PO-%' AND docstatus='CO'

cases.question: How many products are in the catalog, including retired ones?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM m_product WHERE value LIKE 'FH-%'

cases.question: What was total booked revenue in 2026 so far?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.linenetamt), 2) AS revenue FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') AND o.dateordered >= '2026-01-01'

cases.question: How many booked sales orders were placed from November 1 to November 7, 2026, inclusive?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM c_order o WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') AND o.dateordered >= '2026-11-01' AND o.dateordered < '2026-11-08'

cases.question: Show booked revenue by month from December 2025 through October 2026.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.dateordered)::date AS month, ROUND(SUM(ol.linenetamt), 2) AS revenue FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') AND o.dateordered >= '2025-12-01' AND o.dateordered < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many customers placed no booked orders between July 1 and September 30, 2026?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM c_bpartner bp WHERE bp.value LIKE 'DEMO-C%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c_order o WHERE o.c_bpartner_id = bp.c_bpartner_id AND o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') AND o.dateordered >= '2026-07-01' AND o.dateordered < '2026-10-01')

cases.question: What is booked revenue by customer state (state code)?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.name AS state, ROUND(SUM(ol.linenetamt), 2) AS revenue FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id JOIN c_bpartner_location bpl ON bpl.c_bpartner_location_id = o.c_bpartner_location_id JOIN c_location loc ON loc.c_location_id = bpl.c_location_id JOIN c_region r ON r.c_region_id = loc.c_region_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') GROUP BY r.name

cases.question: Show booked revenue by state and month for July through September 2026.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.name AS state, date_trunc('month', o.dateordered)::date AS month, ROUND(SUM(ol.linenetamt), 2) AS revenue FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id JOIN c_bpartner_location bpl ON bpl.c_bpartner_location_id = o.c_bpartner_location_id JOIN c_location loc ON loc.c_location_id = bpl.c_location_id JOIN c_region r ON r.c_region_id = loc.c_region_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') AND o.dateordered >= '2026-07-01' AND o.dateordered < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1, 2

cases.question: How many customers are there in each state?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.name AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT bp.c_bpartner_id) AS customers FROM c_bpartner bp JOIN c_bpartner_location bpl ON bpl.c_bpartner_id = bp.c_bpartner_id JOIN c_location loc ON loc.c_location_id = bpl.c_location_id JOIN c_region r ON r.c_region_id = loc.c_region_id WHERE bp.value LIKE 'DEMO-C%' GROUP BY r.name

cases.question: Which product sold the most units to California customers in 2026? Give SKU, name and units.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.value AS sku, p.name, SUM(ol.qtyordered) AS units FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id = ol.m_product_id JOIN c_bpartner_location bpl ON bpl.c_bpartner_location_id = o.c_bpartner_location_id JOIN c_location loc ON loc.c_location_id = bpl.c_location_id JOIN c_region r ON r.c_region_id = loc.c_region_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') AND r.name='CA' AND o.dateordered >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.value, p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Who are the top 10 customers by booked revenue? Give name and revenue.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT bp.name, ROUND(SUM(ol.linenetamt), 2) AS revenue FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id=o.c_bpartner_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') GROUP BY bp.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: Which 5 customers have placed the most non-voided sales orders? Give name and order count.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT bp.name, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM c_order o JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id=o.c_bpartner_id WHERE o.issotrx='Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus <> 'VO' GROUP BY bp.name ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: What were the top 5 products by units sold in 2026? Give SKU, name and units.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.value AS sku, p.name, SUM(ol.qtyordered) AS units FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id=ol.m_product_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') AND o.dateordered >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.value, p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: What was booked revenue by product type in 2026?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.group1 AS product_type, ROUND(SUM(ol.linenetamt), 2) AS revenue FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id=ol.m_product_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') AND o.dateordered >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.group1

cases.question: How many customers have placed more than 20 booked orders?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT o.c_bpartner_id FROM c_order o WHERE o.issotrx = 'Y' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-SO-%' AND o.docstatus IN ('CO','CL') GROUP BY o.c_bpartner_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 20) t

cases.question: Which active products are below their reorder point? Give SKU, units on hand and the reorder point.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.value AS sku, oh.onhand, rp.level_min AS reorder_point FROM m_product p JOIN m_replenish rp ON rp.m_product_id=p.m_product_id JOIN (SELECT m_product_id, SUM(qtyonhand) AS onhand FROM m_storageonhand GROUP BY m_product_id) oh ON oh.m_product_id=p.m_product_id WHERE p.value LIKE 'FH-%' AND p.isactive='Y' AND oh.onhand < rp.level_min

cases.question: For products below their reorder point, how many units are needed to bring each back up to its maximum level? Give SKU and units needed.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.value AS sku, rp.level_max - oh.onhand AS units_needed FROM m_product p JOIN m_replenish rp ON rp.m_product_id=p.m_product_id JOIN (SELECT m_product_id, SUM(qtyonhand) AS onhand FROM m_storageonhand GROUP BY m_product_id) oh ON oh.m_product_id=p.m_product_id WHERE p.value LIKE 'FH-%' AND p.isactive='Y' AND oh.onhand < rp.level_min

cases.question: How many units of Fernhollow stock are on hand in total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(s.qtyonhand) AS units_on_hand FROM m_storageonhand s JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id=s.m_product_id WHERE p.value LIKE 'FH-%'

cases.question: How many units are on hand per product type, counting active products only?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.group1 AS product_type, SUM(s.qtyonhand) AS units_on_hand FROM m_storageonhand s JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id=s.m_product_id WHERE p.value LIKE 'FH-%' AND p.isactive='Y' GROUP BY p.group1

cases.question: What is the total open purchase order quantity?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(open_qty) AS open_po_qty FROM (SELECT ol.m_product_id, SUM(ol.qtyordered - ol.qtydelivered) AS open_qty FROM c_orderline ol JOIN c_order o ON o.c_order_id = ol.c_order_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'N' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-PO-%' AND o.docstatus = 'CO' AND ol.qtyordered > ol.qtydelivered GROUP BY ol.m_product_id) t

cases.question: What is the open purchase order quantity per vendor? Give the vendor name and quantity.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT bp.name AS vendor, SUM(ol.qtyordered - ol.qtydelivered) AS open_qty FROM c_orderline ol JOIN c_order o ON o.c_order_id=ol.c_order_id JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id=o.c_bpartner_id WHERE o.issotrx='N' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-PO-%' AND o.docstatus='CO' AND ol.qtyordered > ol.qtydelivered GROUP BY bp.name

cases.question: Which active products are below their reorder point and have no open purchase order quantity? Give SKU.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.value AS sku FROM m_product p JOIN m_replenish rp ON rp.m_product_id=p.m_product_id JOIN (SELECT m_product_id, SUM(qtyonhand) AS onhand FROM m_storageonhand GROUP BY m_product_id) oh ON oh.m_product_id=p.m_product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ol.m_product_id, SUM(ol.qtyordered - ol.qtydelivered) AS open_qty FROM c_orderline ol JOIN c_order o ON o.c_order_id = ol.c_order_id WHERE o.issotrx = 'N' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-PO-%' AND o.docstatus = 'CO' AND ol.qtyordered > ol.qtydelivered GROUP BY ol.m_product_id) po ON po.m_product_id=p.m_product_id WHERE p.value LIKE 'FH-%' AND p.isactive='Y' AND oh.onhand < rp.level_min AND COALESCE(po.open_qty, 0) = 0

cases.question: How many completed purchase orders were placed with each vendor?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT bp.name AS vendor, COUNT(*) AS purchase_orders FROM c_order o JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id=o.c_bpartner_id WHERE o.issotrx='N' AND o.documentno LIKE 'FH-PO-%' AND o.docstatus='CO' GROUP BY bp.name

cases.question: What is the average promised lead time in days for each vendor, across the active products they currently supply?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT bp.name AS vendor, ROUND(AVG(po.deliverytime_promised), 2) AS avg_lead_days FROM m_product_po po JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id=po.m_product_id JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id=po.c_bpartner_id WHERE p.value LIKE 'FH-%' AND p.isactive='Y' AND po.iscurrentvendor='Y' GROUP BY bp.name

cases.question: How many active products does each vendor currently supply?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT bp.name AS vendor, COUNT(*) AS active_products FROM m_product_po po JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id=po.m_product_id JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id=po.c_bpartner_id WHERE p.value LIKE 'FH-%' AND p.isactive='Y' AND po.iscurrentvendor='Y' GROUP BY bp.name

cases.question: What are the selling price and the compare-at price of the Vitamin C Serum 1 oz (single, not the 2-pack)?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT pp.pricestd AS price, pp.pricelist AS compare_at_price FROM m_productprice pp JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id=pp.m_product_id WHERE pp.m_pricelist_version_id=104 AND p.value='FH-004-1'

cases.question: Which active products sell below their compare-at price? Give SKU, price and compare-at price.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.value AS sku, pp.pricestd AS price, pp.pricelist AS compare_at_price FROM m_productprice pp JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id=pp.m_product_id WHERE pp.m_pricelist_version_id=104 AND p.value LIKE 'FH-%' AND p.isactive='Y' AND pp.pricestd < pp.pricelist

cases.question: Which 5 active products have the highest unit margin, meaning selling price minus the current vendor's purchase price? Give SKU and margin.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.value AS sku, ROUND(pp.pricestd - po.pricepo, 2) AS unit_margin FROM m_product p JOIN m_productprice pp ON pp.m_product_id=p.m_product_id AND pp.m_pricelist_version_id=104 JOIN m_product_po po ON po.m_product_id=p.m_product_id AND po.iscurrentvendor='Y' WHERE p.value LIKE 'FH-%' AND p.isactive='Y' ORDER BY unit_margin DESC LIMIT 5
